sql_text: SELECT o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS basket_value FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 GROUP BY o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d HAVING SUM(ol.ol_amount) >= 250 ORDER BY basket_value DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS basket_value FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 GROUP BY o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d HAVING SUM(ol.ol_amount) >= 250 ORDER BY basket_value DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) AS completed_at, MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) - o.o_entry_d AS elapsed FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 AND ol.ol_delivery_d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d HAVING MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) - o.o_entry_d > INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY elapsed DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) AS completed_at, MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) - o.o_entry_d AS elapsed FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 AND ol.ol_delivery_d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d HAVING MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) - o.o_entry_d > INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY elapsed DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT i.i_id, i.i_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id JOIN chbenchmark.item i ON i.i_id = ol.ol_i_id WHERE c.c_state = 'WA' GROUP BY i.i_id, i.i_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 150

SELECT i.i_id, i.i_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id JOIN chbenchmark.item i ON i.i_id = ol.ol_i_id WHERE c.c_state = 'WA' GROUP BY i.i_id, i.i_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 150

SELECT ol.ol_supply_w_id, COUNT(*) AS remote_lines, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.order_line ol WHERE ol.ol_w_id = 1 AND ol.ol_supply_w_id <> ol.ol_w_id GROUP BY ol.ol_supply_w_id ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT ol.ol_supply_w_id, COUNT(*) AS remote_lines, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.order_line ol WHERE ol.ol_w_id = 1 AND ol.ol_supply_w_id <> ol.ol_w_id GROUP BY ol.ol_supply_w_id ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last, latest.o_id, latest.o_entry_d, latest.order_value FROM chbenchmark.customer c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS order_value FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id GROUP BY o.o_id, o.o_entry_d ORDER BY o.o_entry_d DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true WHERE c.c_w_id = 3 AND c.c_d_id = 10 ORDER BY latest.o_entry_d DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last, latest.o_id, latest.o_entry_d, latest.order_value FROM chbenchmark.customer c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS order_value FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id GROUP BY o.o_id, o.o_entry_d ORDER BY o.o_entry_d DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true WHERE c.c_w_id = 3 AND c.c_d_id = 10 ORDER BY latest.o_entry_d DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS lifetime_value FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE c.c_w_id = 3 GROUP BY c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last HAVING SUM(ol.ol_amount) > 10000 ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS lifetime_value FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE c.c_w_id = 3 GROUP BY c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last HAVING SUM(ol.ol_amount) > 10000 ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT width_bucket(i_price, 50, 250, 8) AS price_band, COUNT(*) AS items, AVG(i_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i_data ILIKE '%PROMO%') AS promotional FROM chbenchmark.item WHERE i_price BETWEEN 50 AND 250 GROUP BY price_band ORDER BY price_band

SELECT width_bucket(i_price, 50, 250, 8) AS price_band, COUNT(*) AS items, AVG(i_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i_data ILIKE '%PROMO%') AS promotional FROM chbenchmark.item WHERE i_price BETWEEN 50 AND 250 GROUP BY price_band ORDER BY price_band

SELECT su.su_suppkey, su.su_name, COUNT(*) AS supplied_lines, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue, AVG(s.s_quantity) AS avg_stock FROM chbenchmark.supplier su JOIN chbenchmark.stock s ON MOD(s.s_w_id * s.s_i_id, 10000) = su.su_suppkey JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_supply_w_id = s.s_w_id AND ol.ol_i_id = s.s_i_id WHERE su.su_nationkey = 13 GROUP BY su.su_suppkey, su.su_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT su.su_suppkey, su.su_name, COUNT(*) AS supplied_lines, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue, AVG(s.s_quantity) AS avg_stock FROM chbenchmark.supplier su JOIN chbenchmark.stock s ON MOD(s.s_w_id * s.s_i_id, 10000) = su.su_suppkey JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_supply_w_id = s.s_w_id AND ol.ol_i_id = s.s_i_id WHERE su.su_nationkey = 13 GROUP BY su.su_suppkey, su.su_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT c_w_id, c_d_id, c_id, c_balance, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_w_id ORDER BY c_balance DESC) AS balance_rank, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY c_w_id ORDER BY c_balance) AS balance_percentile FROM chbenchmark.customer WHERE c_state = 'NV' ORDER BY c_w_id, balance_rank LIMIT 500

SELECT c_w_id, c_d_id, c_id, c_balance, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_w_id ORDER BY c_balance DESC) AS balance_rank, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY c_w_id ORDER BY c_balance) AS balance_percentile FROM chbenchmark.customer WHERE c_state = 'NV' ORDER BY c_w_id, balance_rank LIMIT 500

SELECT c.c_state, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers, AVG(customer_orders.order_count) AS avg_orders FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN ( SELECT o_w_id, o_d_id, o_c_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM chbenchmark.oorder GROUP BY o_w_id, o_d_id, o_c_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) customer_orders ON customer_orders.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND customer_orders.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND customer_orders.o_c_id = c.c_id GROUP BY c.c_state ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC

SELECT c.c_state, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers, AVG(customer_orders.order_count) AS avg_orders FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN ( SELECT o_w_id, o_d_id, o_c_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM chbenchmark.oorder GROUP BY o_w_id, o_d_id, o_c_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) customer_orders ON customer_orders.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND customer_orders.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND customer_orders.o_c_id = c.c_id GROUP BY c.c_state ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC

SELECT h.h_w_id, h.h_d_id, COUNT(*) AS payments, SUM(h.h_amount) AS amount, COUNT(DISTINCT h.h_c_id) AS customers FROM chbenchmark.history h WHERE h.h_date >= DATE '2025-07-22' - INTERVAL '180 days' AND h.h_amount >= 100 GROUP BY h.h_w_id, h.h_d_id ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT h.h_w_id, h.h_d_id, COUNT(*) AS payments, SUM(h.h_amount) AS amount, COUNT(DISTINCT h.h_c_id) AS customers FROM chbenchmark.history h WHERE h.h_date >= DATE '2025-07-22' - INTERVAL '180 days' AND h.h_amount >= 100 GROUP BY h.h_w_id, h.h_d_id ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT i.i_id, i.i_name, i.i_price, s.s_quantity FROM chbenchmark.item i JOIN chbenchmark.stock s ON s.s_i_id = i.i_id AND s.s_w_id = 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chbenchmark.order_line ol JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = ol.ol_w_id AND o.o_d_id = ol.ol_d_id AND o.o_id = ol.ol_o_id WHERE ol.ol_i_id = i.i_id AND ol.ol_w_id = 1 AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2023-08-24' - INTERVAL '90 days' ) ORDER BY s.s_quantity DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT i.i_id, i.i_name, i.i_price, s.s_quantity FROM chbenchmark.item i JOIN chbenchmark.stock s ON s.s_i_id = i.i_id AND s.s_w_id = 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chbenchmark.order_line ol JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = ol.ol_w_id AND o.o_d_id = ol.ol_d_id AND o.o_id = ol.ol_o_id WHERE ol.ol_i_id = i.i_id AND ol.ol_w_id = 1 AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2023-08-24' - INTERVAL '90 days' ) ORDER BY s.s_quantity DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, su.su_name, i.i_id, i.i_name, MIN(s.s_quantity) AS minimum_quantity FROM chbenchmark.stock s JOIN chbenchmark.item i ON i.i_id = s.s_i_id JOIN chbenchmark.supplier su ON su.su_suppkey = MOD(s.s_w_id * s.s_i_id, 10000) JOIN chbenchmark.nation n ON n.n_nationkey = su.su_nationkey JOIN chbenchmark.region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST' AND s.s_quantity < 40 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, su.su_name, i.i_id, i.i_name ORDER BY minimum_quantity, i.i_id LIMIT 250

SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, su.su_name, i.i_id, i.i_name, MIN(s.s_quantity) AS minimum_quantity FROM chbenchmark.stock s JOIN chbenchmark.item i ON i.i_id = s.s_i_id JOIN chbenchmark.supplier su ON su.su_suppkey = MOD(s.s_w_id * s.s_i_id, 10000) JOIN chbenchmark.nation n ON n.n_nationkey = su.su_nationkey JOIN chbenchmark.region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST' AND s.s_quantity < 40 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, su.su_name, i.i_id, i.i_name ORDER BY minimum_quantity, i.i_id LIMIT 250

SELECT ol_number, SUM(ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol_amount) AS revenue, AVG(ol_amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM chbenchmark.order_line WHERE ol_delivery_d >= DATE '2023-08-18' - INTERVAL '120 days' AND ol_delivery_d < DATE '2023-08-18' + INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY ol_number ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT ol_number, SUM(ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol_amount) AS revenue, AVG(ol_amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM chbenchmark.order_line WHERE ol_delivery_d >= DATE '2023-08-18' - INTERVAL '120 days' AND ol_delivery_d < DATE '2023-08-18' + INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY ol_number ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT no.no_d_id, COUNT(*) AS pending_orders, MIN(o.o_entry_d) AS oldest_order, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS pending_value FROM chbenchmark.new_order no JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = no.no_w_id AND o.o_d_id = no.no_d_id AND o.o_id = no.no_o_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE no.no_w_id = 3 GROUP BY no.no_d_id ORDER BY oldest_order

SELECT no.no_d_id, COUNT(*) AS pending_orders, MIN(o.o_entry_d) AS oldest_order, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS pending_value FROM chbenchmark.new_order no JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = no.no_w_id AND o.o_d_id = no.no_d_id AND o.o_id = no.no_o_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE no.no_w_id = 3 GROUP BY no.no_d_id ORDER BY oldest_order

SELECT o.o_d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 3 AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2023-03-06' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND o.o_entry_d < DATE '2023-03-06' + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY o.o_d_id ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT o.o_d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 3 AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2023-03-06' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND o.o_entry_d < DATE '2023-03-06' + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY o.o_d_id ORDER BY revenue DESC

WITH daily AS ( SELECT o.o_entry_d::date AS day, o.o_d_id, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 GROUP BY o.o_entry_d::date, o.o_d_id ) SELECT day, o_d_id, revenue, AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY o_d_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue FROM daily ORDER BY o_d_id, day

WITH daily AS ( SELECT o.o_entry_d::date AS day, o.o_d_id, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 GROUP BY o.o_entry_d::date, o.o_d_id ) SELECT day, o_d_id, revenue, AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY o_d_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue FROM daily ORDER BY o_d_id, day

SELECT i.i_id, i.i_name, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.item i JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_i_id = i.i_id JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = ol.ol_w_id AND o.o_d_id = ol.ol_d_id AND o.o_id = ol.ol_o_id WHERE i.i_data ILIKE '%PROMO%' AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2025-02-11' - INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY i.i_id, i.i_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT i.i_id, i.i_name, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.item i JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_i_id = i.i_id JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = ol.ol_w_id AND o.o_d_id = ol.ol_d_id AND o.o_id = ol.ol_o_id WHERE i.i_data ILIKE '%PROMO%' AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2025-02-11' - INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY i.i_id, i.i_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT c.c_w_id, c.c_d_id, c.c_id, c.c_balance, COUNT(no.no_o_id) AS pending_orders FROM chbenchmark.customer c LEFT JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id LEFT JOIN chbenchmark.new_order no ON no.no_w_id = o.o_w_id AND no.no_d_id = o.o_d_id AND no.no_o_id = o.o_id WHERE c.c_credit = 'BC' AND c.c_state = 'OH' AND c.c_balance > 5000 GROUP BY c.c_w_id, c.c_d_id, c.c_id, c.c_balance ORDER BY pending_orders DESC, c.c_balance DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT c.c_w_id, c.c_d_id, c.c_id, c.c_balance, COUNT(no.no_o_id) AS pending_orders FROM chbenchmark.customer c LEFT JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id LEFT JOIN chbenchmark.new_order no ON no.no_w_id = o.o_w_id AND no.no_d_id = o.o_d_id AND no.no_o_id = o.o_id WHERE c.c_credit = 'BC' AND c.c_state = 'OH' AND c.c_balance > 5000 GROUP BY c.c_w_id, c.c_d_id, c.c_id, c.c_balance ORDER BY pending_orders DESC, c.c_balance DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT s.s_w_id, COUNT(*) AS sku_count, SUM(s.s_quantity) AS units, SUM(s.s_quantity * i.i_price) AS inventory_value FROM chbenchmark.stock s JOIN chbenchmark.item i ON i.i_id = s.s_i_id WHERE s.s_w_id = 4 AND i.i_data ILIKE '%standard%' GROUP BY s.s_w_id

SELECT s.s_w_id, COUNT(*) AS sku_count, SUM(s.s_quantity) AS units, SUM(s.s_quantity * i.i_price) AS inventory_value FROM chbenchmark.stock s JOIN chbenchmark.item i ON i.i_id = s.s_i_id WHERE s.s_w_id = 4 AND i.i_data ILIKE '%standard%' GROUP BY s.s_w_id

WITH daily AS ( SELECT o.o_entry_d::date AS day, o.o_d_id, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 1 GROUP BY o.o_entry_d::date, o.o_d_id ) SELECT day, o_d_id, revenue, AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY o_d_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue FROM daily ORDER BY o_d_id, day

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS lifetime_value FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE c.c_w_id = 3 GROUP BY c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last HAVING SUM(ol.ol_amount) > 5000 ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS lifetime_value FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE c.c_w_id = 3 GROUP BY c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last HAVING SUM(ol.ol_amount) > 1000 ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, su.su_name, i.i_id, i.i_name, MIN(s.s_quantity) AS minimum_quantity FROM chbenchmark.stock s JOIN chbenchmark.item i ON i.i_id = s.s_i_id JOIN chbenchmark.supplier su ON su.su_suppkey = MOD(s.s_w_id * s.s_i_id, 10000) JOIN chbenchmark.nation n ON n.n_nationkey = su.su_nationkey JOIN chbenchmark.region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND s.s_quantity < 60 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, su.su_name, i.i_id, i.i_name ORDER BY minimum_quantity, i.i_id LIMIT 250

SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, su.su_name, i.i_id, i.i_name, MIN(s.s_quantity) AS minimum_quantity FROM chbenchmark.stock s JOIN chbenchmark.item i ON i.i_id = s.s_i_id JOIN chbenchmark.supplier su ON su.su_suppkey = MOD(s.s_w_id * s.s_i_id, 10000) JOIN chbenchmark.nation n ON n.n_nationkey = su.su_nationkey JOIN chbenchmark.region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND s.s_quantity < 60 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, su.su_name, i.i_id, i.i_name ORDER BY minimum_quantity, i.i_id LIMIT 250

SELECT c.c_state, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers, AVG(customer_orders.order_count) AS avg_orders FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN ( SELECT o_w_id, o_d_id, o_c_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM chbenchmark.oorder GROUP BY o_w_id, o_d_id, o_c_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ) customer_orders ON customer_orders.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND customer_orders.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND customer_orders.o_c_id = c.c_id GROUP BY c.c_state ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC

SELECT c.c_state, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers, AVG(customer_orders.order_count) AS avg_orders FROM chbenchmark.customer c JOIN ( SELECT o_w_id, o_d_id, o_c_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM chbenchmark.oorder GROUP BY o_w_id, o_d_id, o_c_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ) customer_orders ON customer_orders.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND customer_orders.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND customer_orders.o_c_id = c.c_id GROUP BY c.c_state ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC

SELECT su.su_suppkey, su.su_name, COUNT(*) AS supplied_lines, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue, AVG(s.s_quantity) AS avg_stock FROM chbenchmark.supplier su JOIN chbenchmark.stock s ON MOD(s.s_w_id * s.s_i_id, 10000) = su.su_suppkey JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_supply_w_id = s.s_w_id AND ol.ol_i_id = s.s_i_id WHERE su.su_nationkey = 20 GROUP BY su.su_suppkey, su.su_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT su.su_suppkey, su.su_name, COUNT(*) AS supplied_lines, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue, AVG(s.s_quantity) AS avg_stock FROM chbenchmark.supplier su JOIN chbenchmark.stock s ON MOD(s.s_w_id * s.s_i_id, 10000) = su.su_suppkey JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_supply_w_id = s.s_w_id AND ol.ol_i_id = s.s_i_id WHERE su.su_nationkey = 20 GROUP BY su.su_suppkey, su.su_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 200

WITH daily AS ( SELECT o.o_entry_d::date AS day, o.o_d_id, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 GROUP BY o.o_entry_d::date, o.o_d_id ) SELECT day, o_d_id, revenue, AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY o_d_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue FROM daily ORDER BY o_d_id, day

WITH daily AS ( SELECT o.o_entry_d::date AS day, o.o_d_id, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 GROUP BY o.o_entry_d::date, o.o_d_id ) SELECT day, o_d_id, revenue, AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY o_d_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue FROM daily ORDER BY o_d_id, day

SELECT o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) AS completed_at, MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) - o.o_entry_d AS elapsed FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 3 AND ol.ol_delivery_d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d HAVING MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) - o.o_entry_d > INTERVAL '48 hours' ORDER BY elapsed DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) AS completed_at, MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) - o.o_entry_d AS elapsed FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 3 AND ol.ol_delivery_d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d HAVING MAX(ol.ol_delivery_d) - o.o_entry_d > INTERVAL '48 hours' ORDER BY elapsed DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT o.o_d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 1 AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2025-04-05' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND o.o_entry_d < DATE '2025-04-05' + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY o.o_d_id ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT o.o_d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_id) AS orders, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS revenue FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 1 AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2025-04-05' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND o.o_entry_d < DATE '2025-04-05' + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY o.o_d_id ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS basket_value FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 GROUP BY o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d HAVING SUM(ol.ol_amount) >= 750 ORDER BY basket_value DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(ol.ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS basket_value FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = 4 GROUP BY o.o_d_id, o.o_id, o.o_entry_d HAVING SUM(ol.ol_amount) >= 750 ORDER BY basket_value DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT i.i_id, i.i_name, i.i_price, s.s_quantity FROM chbenchmark.item i JOIN chbenchmark.stock s ON s.s_i_id = i.i_id AND s.s_w_id = 4 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chbenchmark.order_line ol JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = ol.ol_w_id AND o.o_d_id = ol.ol_d_id AND o.o_id = ol.ol_o_id WHERE ol.ol_i_id = i.i_id AND ol.ol_w_id = 4 AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2024-06-23' - INTERVAL '90 days' ) ORDER BY s.s_quantity DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT i.i_id, i.i_name, i.i_price, s.s_quantity FROM chbenchmark.item i JOIN chbenchmark.stock s ON s.s_i_id = i.i_id AND s.s_w_id = 4 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chbenchmark.order_line ol JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = ol.ol_w_id AND o.o_d_id = ol.ol_d_id AND o.o_id = ol.ol_o_id WHERE ol.ol_i_id = i.i_id AND ol.ol_w_id = 4 AND o.o_entry_d >= DATE '2024-06-23' - INTERVAL '90 days' ) ORDER BY s.s_quantity DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT c_w_id, c_d_id, c_id, c_balance, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_w_id ORDER BY c_balance DESC) AS balance_rank, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY c_w_id ORDER BY c_balance) AS balance_percentile FROM chbenchmark.customer WHERE c_state = 'FL' ORDER BY c_w_id, balance_rank LIMIT 500

SELECT c_w_id, c_d_id, c_id, c_balance, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_w_id ORDER BY c_balance DESC) AS balance_rank, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY c_w_id ORDER BY c_balance) AS balance_percentile FROM chbenchmark.customer WHERE c_state = 'FL' ORDER BY c_w_id, balance_rank LIMIT 500

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last, latest.o_id, latest.o_entry_d, latest.order_value FROM chbenchmark.customer c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS order_value FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id GROUP BY o.o_id, o.o_entry_d ORDER BY o.o_entry_d DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true WHERE c.c_w_id = 1 AND c.c_d_id = 9 ORDER BY latest.o_entry_d DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_first, c.c_last, latest.o_id, latest.o_entry_d, latest.order_value FROM chbenchmark.customer c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT o.o_id, o.o_entry_d, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS order_value FROM chbenchmark.oorder o JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id GROUP BY o.o_id, o.o_entry_d ORDER BY o.o_entry_d DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true WHERE c.c_w_id = 1 AND c.c_d_id = 9 ORDER BY latest.o_entry_d DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

SELECT ol_number, SUM(ol_quantity) AS units, SUM(ol_amount) AS revenue, AVG(ol_amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM chbenchmark.order_line WHERE ol_delivery_d >= DATE '2023-05-11' - INTERVAL '120 days' AND ol_delivery_d < DATE '2023-05-11' + INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY ol_number ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT no.no_d_id, COUNT(*) AS pending_orders, MIN(o.o_entry_d) AS oldest_order, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS pending_value FROM chbenchmark.new_order no JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = no.no_w_id AND o.o_d_id = no.no_d_id AND o.o_id = no.no_o_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE no.no_w_id = 3 GROUP BY no.no_d_id ORDER BY oldest_order

SELECT no.no_d_id, COUNT(*) AS pending_orders, MIN(o.o_entry_d) AS oldest_order, SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS pending_value FROM chbenchmark.new_order no JOIN chbenchmark.oorder o ON o.o_w_id = no.no_w_id AND o.o_d_id = no.no_d_id AND o.o_id = no.no_o_id JOIN chbenchmark.order_line ol ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id WHERE no.no_w_id = 3 GROUP BY no.no_d_id ORDER BY oldest_order
